subject.title: Suppress failed tool progress in Discord

question: Should this PR require retained redacted Discord proof before merge, or may maintainers accept the unretained canary observation plus focused tests for this Discord-visible suppression?
rationale: The code shape is narrow, but the behavior changes visible Discord message delivery and the only after-fix live evidence is not retained as reviewable proof.

options.title: Require retained Discord proof
options.body: Wait for a redacted Discord transcript, recording, terminal output, or logs showing failed draft progress hidden while expected fallback warnings still reach the channel.

options.title: Accept source-level confidence
options.body: Maintainers may land after branch refresh on the focused source diff and tests while explicitly accepting the missing retained live Discord proof.

options.title: Pause until proof is practical
options.body: Keep the PR open but blocked if neither the contributor nor a maintainer can safely capture the Discord path yet.

recommendation.title: Require retained Discord proof
recommendation.body: Wait for a redacted Discord transcript, recording, terminal output, or logs showing failed draft progress hidden while expected fallback warnings still reach the channel.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent history points to vincentkoc as the strongest routing candidate for Discord and shared progress-preview behavior.
